text:
MQTT::message
Description
This command returns the full content of the MQTT message.
Syntax
MQTT
::
message
Examples
when
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS
{
log
local0.
[
MQTT
::
message
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
R_INGRESS, MR_EGRESS, MR_FAILED, MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS
MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_EGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_EGRESS
